_A_INPUT_TAGS_COMPONENT_DESCRIPTION_: AInputTags enters several free values in one field, e.g. keywords or e-mail recipients. The model is an array of strings.
_A_INPUT_TAGS_ACCESSIBILITY_DESCRIPTION_:
Accessibility:

  • The field is a normal text input with a label. A hint for screen readers explains the keys: Enter or a comma adds a value, Backspace in the empty field removes the last one.
  • Every tag has a remove button with the text "Remove …". After a click the focus goes back to the input.
  • Added and removed values, duplicates and the limit are announced in a live region.
  • Pasted text is split into several values.
_A_INPUT_TAGS_PROPS_ALLOW_DUPLICATES_DES: Allows the same value more than once. Without it a duplicate (case-insensitive) is not added and announced.
_A_INPUT_TAGS_PROPS_MAX_TAGS_DESCRIPTION: Maximum number of values. When it is reached, no more values are added and the limit is announced.
_A_INPUT_TAGS_PROPS_SEPARATORS_DESCRIPTI: Keys that add the typed text as a value, default ["Enter", ","]. One-character separators and line breaks also split pasted text.
_A_INPUT_TAGS_METHODS_FOCUS_DESCRIPTION_: Sets the focus to the input.
_A_INPUT_TAGS_BASIC_DESCRIPTION_: Type a value and press Enter or a comma. The text that is still in the field is added when the field loses the focus.
_A_INPUT_TAGS_EMAILS_DESCRIPTION_: separators adds a semicolon and a space, so a list of addresses can be typed or pasted. max-tags limits the number of recipients. input-attributes gives the mobile keyboard for e-mail addresses.
_A_INPUT_TAGS_FORM_DESCRIPTION_: In AForm the element has the type tags.
_A_INPUT_TAGS_ACCESSIBILITY_MORE_DESCRIP: Keyboard on the values: ArrowLeft at the start of the field goes to the values, the arrows go between them, Home / End to the first / last one, Delete or Backspace removes the value and the focus stays on the values, ArrowRight after the last one goes back to the field. With data or url the field is a combobox like ACombobox (role="combobox", the suggestions in a listbox). "+N" (max-visible-tags) has aria-expanded, its name contains the visible text. The counter of max-tags is read with the field.
_A_INPUT_TAGS_SUGGESTIONS_DESCRIPTION_: With data (or url) the field shows suggestions like ACombobox: groups, disabled suggestions, filter, in-body and the bottom sheet. Enter or a click adds the suggestion, chosen values are no suggestions. is-add-all adds all found suggestions (button under the list or Ctrl+Enter).
_A_INPUT_TAGS_LIMITS_HEADER_: Only from the list and limits
_A_INPUT_TAGS_LIMITS_DESCRIPTION_: is-only-from-list accepts only values of the suggestions. max-tags limits the number and shows a counter, max-visible-tags hides more values behind "+N", is-remove-all shows a button that removes all values.
_A_INPUT_TAGS_PROPS_IS_ADD_ALL_DESCRIPTI: Shows a button "add all" under the suggestions, Ctrl+Enter does the same; disabled suggestions and max-tags are respected.
_A_INPUT_TAGS_PROPS_IS_ONLY_FROM_LIST_DE: Only values of the suggestions (also typed or pasted, without the case and diacritics); another text is announced and not added.
_A_INPUT_TAGS_PROPS_IS_REMOVE_ALL_DESCRI: Shows a button under the field that removes all values; the removal is announced, the focus goes to the field.
_A_INPUT_TAGS_PROPS_MAX_VISIBLE_TAGS_DES: Number of visible values; the others are behind a button "+N" (aria-expanded) that shows them.
_A_INPUT_TAGS_PROPS_TEXTS_DESCRIPTION_: All texts of the field: added, removed, duplicate, max, remove, hint, removeAll, removedAll, showMore, showLess, counter, onlyFromList, addAll, hintAddAll, hintSortable, invalid, maxlength, editing, moved, loading, noResults, results. Every missing key keeps its default, the defaults can be set with AComponentsPlugin.
_A_INPUT_TAGS_EVENTS_UPDATE_MODEL_VALUE_: The new values (v-model), an array of strings.
_A_INPUT_TAGS_PROPS_ADD_ON_BLUR_DESCRIPT: The typed text becomes a value when the field loses the focus. With false it stays in the field and an edit is canceled.
_A_INPUT_TAGS_PROPS_ICON_APPEND_DESCRIPT: Icon at the end of the field, a name of AIconPlugin.
_A_INPUT_TAGS_PROPS_IS_CLEAR_BUTTON_DESC: A button that clears the typed text (not the values), shown while there is text.
_A_INPUT_TAGS_PROPS_IS_SORTABLE_DESCRIPT: The order of the values can be changed: Alt+ArrowLeft / Alt+ArrowRight on a value and drag and drop. The new position is announced.
_A_INPUT_TAGS_PROPS_MAXLENGTH_DESCRIPTIO: Maximum length of one value; a longer text is not added, the reason is shown and announced.
_A_INPUT_TAGS_PROPS_MODEL_KEY_DESCRIPTIO: "id": the model has the ids of the suggestions, the values show their labels. With url the labels of unknown ids are loaded (url-retrieve or url).
_A_INPUT_TAGS_PROPS_SIZE_DESCRIPTION_: Size of the field: small, medium or large.
_A_INPUT_TAGS_PROPS_TAG_CLASS_DESCRIPTIO: Class of every value or a function ({ tag, label, index }) => class.
_A_INPUT_TAGS_PROPS_TRANSFORM_DESCRIPTIO: Changes the text before the checks, e.g. value => value.toLowerCase().
_A_INPUT_TAGS_PROPS_URL_RETRIEVE_DESCRIP: model-key "id": the address for the labels of the ids in the model (GET with the ids in key-id and limit). Without it url is used.
_A_INPUT_TAGS_PROPS_VALIDATOR_DESCRIPTIO: Check of a value: ({ tag, tags }) => true | false | "message". false shows the default text, a text (also a translation key, {{ tag }}) is the message; the value is not added, the reason is shown and announced.
_A_INPUT_TAGS_VALIDATION_DESCRIPTION_: validator checks an e-mail, transform puts it in lower case, maxlength limits one value. A refused value stays in the field, the reason is shown and announced.
_A_INPUT_TAGS_ORDER_DESCRIPTION_: is-sortable: Alt+arrows on a value or drag and drop change the order. F2 or a double click puts a value into the field, Enter puts it back at its place, Escape cancels. tag-class marks the first step, size small.
_A_INPUT_TAGS_MODEL_KEY_DESCRIPTION_: With model-key "id" the model has the ids of the suggestions, the values show their labels. A typed label (also without the case and diacritics) is its id.
